description: This file defines a custom exception class `ProjectServiceException` within the OrangeHRM Time module, specifically in the Exception namespace. It provides static methods to generate exceptions related to project activities, such as duplication, existence, and not found scenarios.

classes.name: ProjectServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling project service related errors within the OrangeHRM Time module.

methods.name: projectActivityExist
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that project activities with logged time cannot be deleted.

methods.name: duplicateProjectActivityNameFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that a duplicate project activity name was found.

methods.name: projectActivityNotFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that the project activity was not found.
